name: UI：任务管理-分配明细表格列名验证
description: 验证分配明细弹窗内表格包含：审核人/状态&进度/任务时长/通过率/操作

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { hasModal: false }; const headers = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('th')).map(th => th.textContent.trim()); const expected = ['审核人','状态','进度','任务时长','通过率','操作']; const found = expected.filter(e => headers.some(h => h.includes(e))); return { hasModal: true, headers, expected, found, coverage: found.length+'/'+expected.length }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在任务管理数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 5列：审核人/状态&进度/任务时长/通过率/操作
